{{Top|leg}}
'''Panto Prime''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Panto system]]. It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]] and [[Toloran]], and was a luxury facility that served as both a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and [[Casino/Legends|casino]]. It was a popular [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] resort.
